name: Paint Scribble
description: Loose brush-like glyphs in a mixed ink palette, layered with shadow offsets like a quick gestural sketch.

code.style: --rule: ( @content: @unicode.r(0x30A0, 0x30CF); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: @r(5vmin, 18vmin); color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); font-weight: bold; overflow: visible; transform: rotate(@r(360deg)) translate(@r(-30%, 30%), @r(-30%, 30%)); text-shadow: @m(8, (calc(@n() * .12vmin) calc(@n() * .12vmin) 0 @pn(currentColor, var(--color0)))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
